compute_chunked_selective_log_softmax: compute per-token log probabilities from logits using a memory-efficient chunked log softmax approach
compute_hidden_states_selective_log_soft: compute per-token log probabilities from hidden states and lm_head with optional logit scaling and softcapping
compute_grpo_loss: compute GRPO reinforcement learning loss supporting grpo, sapo, cispo, bnpo, dr_grpo, and dapo loss types
run_efficient_grpo_backward: run the memory-efficient UnslothEfficientGRPO autograd function for chunked forward and backward GRPO passes
compute_grpo_accumulated_loss: compute the full accumulated GRPO loss with vision model support, autotuned batching, and CPU offloading
